about: Jarvis for Chrome relay envelope vectors (wire v1, SPEC 32.1). AES-GCM-256 with `key`; additional data = UTF-8 of `${box}|${id}`; ct = ciphertext then the 16-byte tag; all base64url without padding. Every case is read at `now` (ms) by a receiver of `box`. `valid`: sealing `plaintext` (exact UTF-8 bytes) with `id` and `iv` gives `ct`, and opening it gives `message`. `drop`: the receiver must drop `envelope` silently (`reason` is this implementation's name for why). `replay`: opening `envelope` once is fine; the second time it must be dropped.
